description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git behavior related to directory and symlink merging, conflict resolution, and checkout operations in a version-controlled environment.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, setting up and verifying Git operations and merge behaviors.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that specified commands fail as expected.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link with specific conditions in the test environment.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
